g.text: E020 · full-request latency and output throughput
M5 Ultra 256 GiB · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · C1 · 19 input / 32 output
Better = upper left. Three fresh servers per configuration; same-run target-only anchors.
Large marks: medians of three fresh process medians. Faint marks: all process medians; no confidence intervals.
Failed process diagnostics: red × (0); no valid configuration point unless all three processes pass.
C1 and fixed 32 output tokens make throughput = 32 / E2E latency. This is not a concurrency frontier sweep.
Correctness is a prerequisite under each engine’s qualified output contract; cross-engine token identity is not claimed.
Normal EOS; cache hits rejected. External live raw IDs unavailable: visible IDs checked against prior engine qualification.
